text: Speak!” Hook demanded. “I am James Hook,” replied the voice, “captain of the Jolly Roger.” “You are not; you are not,” Hook cried hoarsely. “Brimstone and gall,” the voice retorted, “say that again, and I’ll cast anchor in you.” Hook tried a more ingratiating manner. “If you are Hook,” he said almost humbly, “come tell me, who am I?” “A codfish,” replied the voice, “only a codfish.” “A codfish!” Hook echoed blankly, and it was then, but not till then, that his proud spirit broke. He saw his men draw back from him.
